name: heimdall-asc
description: Every App Store Connect and StoreKit 2 endpoint, narrowed to the profile you pick.
long_description:
Heimdall serves the App Store Connect API and the App Store Server API (StoreKit 2), with every tool generated from Apple's own OpenAPI specification. Pick one profile at install time — distribution, monetization, marketing, testflight and nine more — and only that area's tools are served.

The key never leaves this machine: Heimdall reads it, signs a short-lived token, and talks to Apple directly. Nothing sits in between.

If you have already run `npx -y @erayendes/asc-mcp setup`, leave the credential fields below empty — the shared config it wrote is used instead, with the key still in the Keychain.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Which area of App Store Connect to serve. One bundle serves one profile; install it again with a different profile to add another.

key_id.title: Key ID
key_id.description: From App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations. Leave empty to use the credentials `asc-mcp setup` already wrote.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Shown above the key list on the same page. Leave empty to use the credentials `asc-mcp setup` already wrote.

private_key_path.title: Private key (.p8)
private_key_path.description: The file Apple let you download exactly once. Heimdall reads it to sign a short-lived token; it is never sent anywhere. Leave empty if `asc-mcp setup` already put your key in the Keychain — that is the better place for it.

vendor_number.title: Vendor number
vendor_number.description: Only for sales and finance reports. Payments and Financial Reports → the number beside your legal entity.

bundle_id.title: Bundle ID
bundle_id.description: Only for StoreKit 2 — customer transactions, entitlements and refunds. The App Store Server API is scoped to one app, so these tools appear only when this is set.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Serve only tools that cannot change anything. A server that cannot write cannot write by accident.
